subject: S20 contract: youtube_candidates queue (video_candidates, approve/reject/add_by_url)
body:
# Contract S20 -> S19: `youtube_candidates` queue (backend-owned by S20, rendered by S19's queues hub)

Table `video_candidates` (migration 0018, S20): `media_id` (FK media_assets, PK), `section_id`, `taxonomy_ids text[]`, `score real`,
`matched_terms text[]`, `status 'pending'|'approved'|'rejected'|'stale'`, `reviewed_by uuid`, `reviewed_at`, `created_at`.
Backend-only: RLS on, no grants to `authenticated`; S19 reads it through the API only (admin gate = S19's admin dependency).

Python (S20 ships `naadi_api/youtube/queue.py`, no HTTP of its own for the admin side):
```python
async def list_candidates(db, *, status="pending", limit=50, cursor=None) -> list[CandidateOut]
   # CandidateOut: media_id, youtube_id, title, channel_id, channel_name, duration_s, score, matched_terms,
   #               section_id, section_heading, chapter_id, taxonomy_ids, status, created_at
async def approve(db, media_id, *, reviewer: UUID, section_id=None, start_s=None, end_s=None) -> ApproveResult
   # sets media_assets.review_status='approved', candidate.status='approved', upserts section_media(section_id, media_id, start_s, end_s)
async def reject(db, media_id, *, reviewer: UUID) -> None   # keeps the row so the mapper never proposes it again
```
Queue registry hook for S19's hub (your registry, my registration): I call
`register_queue(key="youtube_candidates", label_key="admin.queue.youtube", list=list_candidates, count=pending_count, actions={"approve": approve, "reject": reject})`
from `naadi_api/youtube/__init__.py` once `naadi_api/admin/queues.py` exists. Tell me the exact signature you ship; until then S20 exposes the functions above and nothing else.
"Add a YouTube video" dialog (S19): call `naadi_api.youtube.add_by_url(db, url_or_id, section_id, reviewer, start_s, end_s)` -> validates via videos.list (embeddable, public), inserts the media_assets row `source_id 'youtube'`, returns the candidate. Quota/cached.
UI copy keys are `video.*`; S19 owns `admin.*`.
